title: Hanz talks about your worries

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Ahoy ahoy. New Thad. How's your day?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahoy ahoy. New Thad. How's your day?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Been better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Been better.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Worrying about debt in Nivalis is like worrying about getting wet while you're drowning. The debt won't get you. Something else will first. Let your kids worry about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Worrying about debt in Nivalis is like worrying about getting wet while you're drowning. The debt won't get you. Something else will first. Let your kids worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Nonsense! This isn't the first LUZ, and it won't be the last. It's keeping us safe - maybe - but more importantly, it's good for business!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nonsense! This isn't the first LUZ, and it won't be the last. It's keeping us safe - maybe - but more importantly, it's good for business!

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Well this has been fun, but my shift starts in five. See you later New Thadd.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well this has been fun, but my shift starts in five. See you later New Thadd.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The killer wasn't fictional.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The killer wasn't fictional.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I kinda envy you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I kinda envy you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I believe that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I believe that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not bad.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Good to hear it. But you look like a bad thought has burrowed its way into your head, and it's carved some worry lines on the way in. What's eating you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good to hear it. But you look like a bad thought has burrowed its way into your head, and it's carved some worry lines on the way in. What's eating you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Debt problems.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Debt problems.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The LUZ is making me feel claustrophobic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The LUZ is making me feel claustrophobic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The LUZ is making me feel claustrophobic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The LUZ is making me feel claustrophobic.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: What's eating you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's eating you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just worried about being murdered.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just worried about being murdered.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think that's what my parents did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think that's what my parents did.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think that's what my parents did.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think that's what my parents did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like good advice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That doesn't sound like good advice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That doesn't sound like good advice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That doesn't sound like good advice.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Oh come on! This week it's a serial killer, next week it's a logic virus, the week after... a fucking sentient fungus invasion. Villain of the week stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh come on! This week it's a serial killer, next week it's a logic virus, the week after... a fucking sentient fungus invasion. Villain of the week stuff.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think the killer is fictional?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think the killer is fictional?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think the killer is fictional?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think the killer is fictional?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sentient... fungus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sentient... fungus?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: No, obviously not that exactly but... in that genre. You know what I mean! Something to scare the plebians.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, obviously not that exactly but... in that genre. You know what I mean! Something to scare the plebians.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aren't you worried about the killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aren't you worried about the killer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aren't you worried about the killer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aren't you worried about the killer?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: What are you going to do? Pay your debts? Where's the fun in that? As long as bounty hunters aren't after you, why not have some fun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you going to do? Pay your debts? Where's the fun in that? As long as bounty hunters aren't after you, why not have some fun?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if they are?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if they are?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Then I have NO IDEA where you are. In fact, I've never even met you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I have NO IDEA where you are. In fact, I've never even met you.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Who knows? Probably... I should get back to work. My shift starts in five. Look after yourself New Thadd.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who knows? Probably... I should get back to work. My shift starts in five. Look after yourself New Thadd.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I still can't quite get over the motives of Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still can't quite get over the motives of Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I still can't quite get over the motives of Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I still can't quite get over the motives of Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The motives of that killer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The motives of that killer.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Good for business. People spend more money when they think there's no future to save for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good for business. People spend more money when they think there's no future to save for.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is that good for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is that good for?
